full_name: IAA Conference on Dynamics and Control of Space Systems
organizer: International Academy of Astronautics (IAA) with the American Astronautical Society (AAS) (proceedings in AAS Advances in the Astronautical Sciences, Univelt); local hosts: GAUSS Srl (Rome 2014), RUDN University (Moscow 2017), National University of Defense Technology College of Aerospace Engineering (Changsha 2018)
frequency: nominally biennial (2012, 2014, 2017, 2018); no edition found after 2018

submission.type: abstract (max 500 words, via EasyChair) -> full manuscript for accepted papers; proceedings in AAS Advances in the Astronautical Sciences; selected papers to Acta Astronautica
submission.notes: 2017 EasyChair lists abstract registration deadline 15 Mar 2017 but guidelines say 1 Mar 2017; 2018 EasyChair header says 28 Feb 2018 but guidelines say 31 Jan 2018.

editions.notes: Proceedings: AAS Advances in the Astronautical Sciences vol. 153. Local organizer GAUSS (https://www.gaussteam.com/?p=6132).

editions.venue: Peoples' Friendship University of Russia (RUDN University)
editions.notes: Abstract deadline ambiguous: 15 Mar 2017 (EasyChair header) vs 1 Mar 2017 (guidelines). Proceedings AAS vol. 161.
Abstract deadline ambiguous: 28 Feb 2018 (header) vs 31 Jan 2018 (guidelines). Proceedings AAS vol. 165 (https://www.univelt.com/linkedfiles/v165%20Contents.pdf).

notes: Included because it is the IAA series most directly on GNC/dynamics, but it appears DORMANT: IAA's historic-events chronicle lists DyCoSS 2012 Porto, 2014 Roma, 2017 Moscow, 2018 Changsha only; searches for a 5th edition found nothing, and DyCoSS is not in the current IAA conference portfolio. No official series website. 1st edition: Porto, Portugal, 19-21 Mar 2012 (outside 2014+ window).
